steps.en: Offender gets a URA letter with a unique link
steps.id: Offender menerima surat URA berisi link unik
steps.why_en: No letter or unique link for bank details exists in the system.
steps.why_id: Sistem tidak punya surat atau link unik untuk data bank.

steps.en: The link opens the bank details page
steps.id: Link terbuka ke halaman data bank
steps.why_en: The portal has only payment and furnish pages; no bank details page exists.
steps.why_id: Portal hanya punya halaman pembayaran dan furnish; halaman data bank tidak ada.

steps.why_en: There is no form or field for bank account details.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada form atau field untuk data rekening bank.

steps.why_en: Nothing in the system can save bank account details.
steps.why_id: Sistem tidak punya penyimpanan data rekening bank.

steps.en: URA receives the details to start the refund
steps.id: URA menerima data untuk memulai refund
steps.why_en: No hand-over of bank details to URA exists in the code.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada penyerahan data bank ke URA di code.
